scope:
Original phase acknowledgements, ring retirement and initialized-group CAN paths.

The larger fixture executes62 individual original initialization functions;
it is not a complete boot/peripheral model. Ring oracle inputs and measured
sources are explicit. No instruction or callback is stubbed.
limits: Boundary ring records/ack inputs are synthetic; integrated lifecycles use actual initialized groups. Code9 release uses explicit80D8 input64/63 after prolonged hold. Complete boot/task/hardware, source units, ascending predicate semantics and multi-request calibration remain open.
